title.narrative: Förstudie om lokala myndigheter i MENA regionen 2021
Study on local gov in MENA Region 2021

description.narrative:
Sveriges Kommuner och Regioner har inkommit med en ansökan om finansering om totalt 4 776 000 SEK för att genomföra en förstudie med syfte att utreda förutsättningar för fortsatt möjligt samarbete kring stöd för lokala myndigheter i länder som ingår i den svenska regionala samarbetsstrategin för MENA regionen 2021-2025. Tiden för genomförandet av förstudien planeras vara cirka åtta (8) månader och ske i huvudsak under 2021. Länderna som förstudien ska fokusera på är; Libanon, Tunisien, Algeriet samt Marocko.
Den totala budgeten för studien är SEK 4 776 000 vilket finansieras av Sida i sin helhet.

Sveriges Kommuner och Regioner, (SKR), has submitted a proposal for financing in total of SEK 4,776,000 to conduct a preliminary study with the aim of preparing for program proposal with the intention of leading to future support to local government authorities in countries that are part of the Swedish Regional MENA strategy for development cooperation 2021-2025. The time-period estimated to conduct the preliminary study is estimated to be around 8 months and will mainly be conducted during 2021. The countries targeted are the following; Lebanon, Tunisia, Algeria and Morocco.
The total budget for the study is SEK 4,776,000, which will be financed by Sida in its entirety.

The intervention was conducted in the form of a pre-study performed by SKR/SALAR, with the overall aim to explore the possibilities of continuing the past cooperation focusing on Tunisia with a regional cooperation regarding local governance in the MENA region, with a focus on Lebanon, Tunisia, Algeria and Morocco. The aim of the pre-study was to:
- Provide an overview and situational analysis of the current situation in the targeted countries in relation to local governance, decentralisation, local service delivery including issues of transparency, accountability and participation.
- Map current needs in the above areas, ongoing reforms to link up to other relevant actors and ongoing partnerships, in order to understand wherre Swedish support could add value.
- Explore conditions for implementation of programs in the targeted countries, including issues of registration, permits, security etc.
- Propose and describe a program in support of relevant focus areas, that are clearly embedded in the local context and needs, and in line with the regional strategy for the MENA region.
